Sodalicious! We update our game every week with exciting levels, improvements to the game, and fun new features. Download the latest version to check it out!
Joining us after a break? Welcome back! New to the game? You’ll be a pro before you know it!

title: Top Lords
notes:
Added prerequisite building upgrade prompts for Castle Lv.10 or below. From there, you can go directly to the specific building upgrade.
Added rewards for clearing Village stages. Lords who have already cleared these stages will receive the rewards via Mail.

title: Puzzles & Survival
notes:
The brand-new version is now live! 
[New Cosmetics] Halloween-themed cosmetics are now available! 
[New M.Card] The Gold M.Card is now available, replacing the Journey Supply M.Card! 
[New Feature] Match-3: Bomb Fusion is here for a limited time—fuse two identical Defense Grenades, Blast Grenades, or Stun Grenades! 
[New Stages] 10 new stages added to Sorting Reagent and Gem Master in the Mini-Game Center!
